causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to HE        detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Very soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Very soft water"

causes.label: Too much detergent
remedies: Measure your detergent carefully.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Too much detergent"

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and the washing machine.
Make sure the end of the drain hose is correctly inserted and secured to the drain.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets and turn the water off after each use.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they may need replacement after 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Using too much detergent in washer
remedies: Use less detergent.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Using too much detergent in washer"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off or improperly connected
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on and make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Water supply is turned off or improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Remove screens and use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reinstall screens, reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: House water heater is not set properly
remedies: Make sure house water heater is delivering water at 120°F–135°F (49°C–57°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "House water heater is not set properly"

causes.label: Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected
remedies: Straighten drain hose and make sure washer is not sitting on it.
Top of drain outlet should be less than 8 ft. above floor.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected"

causes.label: Pump filter clogged
remedies: Remove and clean pump filter.
See the Pump Filter and Housing section in the Care and Cleaning.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Pump filter clogged"

causes.label: The washer normally pauses between washing steps
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "The washer normally pauses between washing steps"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Make sure all selections have been made.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Lid is open
remedies: Close lid and press Start/Pause.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Lid is open"

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/ blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/ blown"

causes.label: Washer is uneven
remedies: Level the washer.
See Leveling the Washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Washer is uneven"

causes.label: Washer load is unbalanced
remedies: Press the Start/Pause button to stop the washer, open the lid and redistribute the load evenly.
Close the lid and restart.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Washer load is unbalanced"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Not enough detergent
remedies: Use more detergent (especially with larger loads).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Not enough detergent"

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use a water conditioner like Calgon brand or install a water softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Hard water"

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°F–135°F (49°C–57°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Washer is overloaded
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer basket
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Washer is overloaded"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Clothes are air or line dried
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Clothes are air or line dried"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time than larger loads.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer basket
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Overloading"

causes.label: Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics
remedies: While this is not caused by the washer, you can slow the pilling process by washing garments inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics"

symptoms.symptom: Snags, holes, tears, rips or excessive wear

causes.label: Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers, and sharp objects left in pockets
remedies: Fasten snaps, hooks, buttons and zippers.
Remove loose items like pins, objects in pockets and sharp buttons.
Turn knits (which snag easily) inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers, and sharp objects left in pockets"

causes.label: Undiluted chlorine bleach
remedies: Check bleach package instructions for proper amount.
Never add undiluted bleach to wash or allow clothes to come in contact with undiluted bleach.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Undiluted chlorine bleach"

causes.label: Chemicals like hair bleach or dye, permanent wave solution
remedies: Rinse items that may have chemicals on them before washing.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Chemicals like hair bleach or dye, permanent wave solution"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Avoid mixing heavy items (like work clothes) with light items (like blouses).
Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Overloading or incorrect water level
remedies: Load your washer so clothes have enough room to move freely.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Overloading or incorrect water level"

causes.label: Repeated washing in water that is too hot
remedies: Wash in warm or cold water.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Repeated washing in water that is too hot"
